Issue Description: The deactivation callback dereferences connection without a null check which can crash if framework passes a null remote connection.
Suggested Fix: Guard the pointer before dereferencing and return early when it is null.

Issue Description: The active configuration descriptor is acquired but never released causing a leak on repeated calls.
Suggested Fix: Call libusb_free_config_descriptor(config_desc) after the descriptor is consumed.

Issue Description: Success and failure handling are inverted so valid device info goes into the failure path and parent data may be computed on error.
Suggested Fix: Change the condition to compare for success and keep warning only on failure.
